title: UAPI: add CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_FINALIZE ioctl
description:
Add CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_FINALIZE to include/uapi/crypto2dev_ioctl.h.

Changes:
- New ioctl: CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_FINALIZE = _IO('W', 20) — no struct, no data transfer
- Update header comment to describe the new write/read/finalize flow
- Update usage examples in header: all three algorithms (CBC, GCM, SHA) must show FINALIZE step
- No changes to existing ioctl numbers

This ioctl is the only UAPI change required. Provider API changes are internal.
